name_input: M/S INSEL RECTIFIRES INDIA PVT.LTD.; INSEL RECTIFIERS (INDIA) PVT. LTD
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs view (slug 'insel-rectifiers-india-private-limited') shows 1643 records, 23 counterparties, 19 port lanes, latest cargo 2026-02-21. Every visible row has India as DESTINATION, e.g. exact line: "2026-02-21 | ZHEJIANG DUKEN ELECTRIC CO.LTD. | INSEL RECTIFIERS (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED | SKKT162 STRUCTURE WITH ACCESSORIES ( PART FOR DIODE AND THYRISTOR) CAPTIVE CONSUMPTION | PADANG, CHINA | DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | 85419000 | 7662014". Rows where the company sits in the supplier column are the same inbound rows (e.g. "2026-02-18 | INSEL RECTIFIERS (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED | DEAN TECHNOLOGY, INC | ... | DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | NEW YORK, UNITED STATES | 85415900 | 9771706"), i.e. a field-placement artifact of the free view, not an outbound shipment. No record seen with an Indian port of loading and a foreign destination. Source counter: page claims 1643 shipments; rows actually visible = 5 shipment rows + 5 supplier rows + 5 buyer rows + 5 port rows. Declared HS 854110 does not match observed codes (85419000, 85415900, 85413010) — HS to be corrected to actual, not a rejection ground.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report split could be retrieved: web_search backend returned "no results (searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>)" on both attempts, and zaubacorp/volza/eximpedia/trademo/importgenius returned HTTP 403 or JS challenge. Only indirect domestic signal: the company appears as a co-buyer alongside Indian firms CONCLUSIVE SEMICONDUCTORS PRIVATE LIMITED and HIND RECTIFIERS LIMITED in the same supplier relationships (e.g. "148 | ZHEJIANG GUCHI ELECTRONICS CO.,LTD | INSEL RECTIFIERS (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED, CONCLUSIVE SEMICONDUCTORS PRIVATE LIMITED, HIND RECTIFIERS LIMITED"), which indicates an operating Indian trading/manufacturing entity but is not a supply record. No domestic supply evidence confirmed.
note: Registered address per ImportKey: "15/C-40 CONNAUGHT PLACE" (Delhi), with a second address variant "FLOOR 1/6/7" in supplier rows; legal name confirmed as INSEL RECTIFIERS (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED. Role: importer/trader of semiconductor devices (thyristors, rectifier stacks, selenium surge suppressors) with captive consumption declared — i.e. manufacturer_trader, not a pure exporter. Factuality per Rule 5: (a) export shipments — no outbound record found, all 1643 customs records are inbound to India (Delhi Air Cargo); (b) domestic supplies — no GST/tender/contract evidence retrievable, so 'declared_only' at best and effectively no trace of domestic supply found; (c) confirmation basis — ImportKey free view only, 5 rows actually seen versus 1643 claimed. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in any accessible source, not estimated. HS 854110 declared vs 85419000/85415900/85413010 observed: correct the code to actual, verdict accepted_hs_corrected, no rejection. No sanctions/court/insolvency check performed (out of scope for this role and not a rejection ground per Rule 2).
